top_issues: Hero shows At risk $115.00 = 100% of balance in violet with no reassurance line, so a first-timer reads 'all my money is in danger'.
'Move' floats as an orphan header between BALANCES and '1 empty hidden' with no column under it; the H1 card's 'receive up to 0.50' contradicts the home line 'receive up to $327.75'.
fixes: Add a one-line gloss under the breakdown, e.g. 'At risk = a hub's promise to you, disputable in 1 d', and label the home 'receive up to' as the cross-account total so it stops clashing with the per-account 0.50.
Delete the orphan 'Move' header from the BALANCES row or turn it into a real column with values.

top_issues: 'Delivery  Instant  Change' — the trailing 'Change' link is unlabelled; a user cannot tell if it changes delivery speed, the route, or the asset.
The same 'Your account with H1' before/after bar is rendered twice (left form and right panel), and the 'This payment 25.00' bar is an empty sliver that conveys nothing.
fixes: Rename the link to its verb, e.g. 'Change route', and remove the duplicated account bar from the right panel (keep the route + provable cards there).
Either drop the per-payment mini-bar or add a caption '25 of 115 used' so the sliver has meaning.

top_issues: No Share / Forward / Download-receipt action — Sofia cannot hand this to a client from the paid modal; only 'Done' exists.
'Settled 05:25:19 in 7979 ms' flaunts a sub-8s number as if instant and uses false precision; the Proof hash is truncated with no copy button.
fixes: Add a secondary 'Forward receipt' button beside Done that copies a shareable proof link.
Round the latency to 'under 8 s' or omit it, and make the Proof value copy-on-click.

top_issues: Three copy affordances ('Copy invoice', 'Copy link', 'Copy xln:// app link') plus jargon '25.50 capacity via H1' leave Maya unsure what to send a payer.
A meaningless green scale-bar sits under the empty '0.00' amount field, implying data where there is none.
fixes: Collapse to one primary 'Copy payment link' with the other two as a 'More' menu, and replace 'capacity via H1' with 'you can receive up to 25.50 here'.
Hide the amount bar until a non-zero amount is typed.

top_issues: 'You receive 0.00' never updates for the 100 USDC entered and there is no market/quote path — Anya cannot see the price she will actually get or a fill.
Sell side is drawn in red, contradicting Settings' promise that 'Red stays for disputes'; the 'Across networks' toggle is dimmed and unusable.
fixes: Compute and display 'You receive ≈ X WETH' live from the book, and add an explicit 'Market' vs 'Limit' mode.
Use amber/neutral for asks and reserve red for disputes only; enable or remove the Across-networks toggle.

top_issues: +90.00 owed, 100.00 collateral, 115.50 credit line and a 190/25.50 send-receive bar do not visibly reconcile, so Tomasz must do the math to read his risk.
The top legend (collateral/at risk/you owe/credit room/in flight) uses dashes, but the lane bars use segments plus an unlabeled tick marker — the mapping is guesswork.
fixes: Add a one-line equation under the position, e.g. 'exposure 90.00 < collateral 100.00 → fully secured', and label the tick as 'current position'.
Render the legend swatches as the same segment colors used in the bars.

top_issues: Per-row micro-bars (violet under Sent, green under Received) have no caption or scale reference, reading as decoration rather than the 'one absolute scale' promise.
No date grouping beyond TODAY and no search — a treasurer auditing weeks of movement must scroll.
fixes: Caption the row bar once ('bar = $ at 1px=$1') or remove it from the list and keep it only in the detail panel.
Add day/week separators and a filter-by-date control.

top_issues: This 'detail' frame is pixel-identical to 07-activity — there is no distinct selected-state visual or expanded evidence, so the detail deliverable is missing.
The detail panel's Proof hash is truncated with no copy or 'open in explorer / verify' action, undercutting Ravi's export-proof task.
fixes: Introduce a real detail layout: full frame hash, the two committed entries, signature list, and a 'Save evidence bundle' button mirroring Sovereignty.
Make Proof copyable and add a Verify action.

top_issues: 'Forget vault' (destructive, red) sits immediately next to 'Lock' with no visible confirmation step — a one-tap irreversible action.

'Dollars per pixel' and 'presets · yours to change' are clever but assume the user already understands the absolute-scale metaphor; the right panel helps but the slider has no live preview of the user's own balances.
fixes: Move 'Forget vault' below a divider and gate it behind a typed/confirm dialog; keep 'Lock' as the only adjacent action.
Show the scale preview against the user's largest real balance, not only the $1,284,500 sample.

top_issues: Contradictory prefill: Account shows 190.00 in BOTH FROM and TO, Reserve (selected) shows 0.00, yet amount is 250 — the form opens in an impossible state with 'Amount exceeds what is available here'.
'WHAT HAPPENS' presents a single radio option 'Fund you through H1', and the disabled 'Sign & send' label has near-invisible contrast.
fixes: Prevent FROM==TO selection, zero the amount on source change, and cap it at available; show the disabled CTA at readable contrast with a tooltip reason.
Render the outcome as a sentence, not a one-item radio.

top_issues: No Dispute entry point anywhere on Manage, yet the money-stands gloss and Sovereignty both tell the user to dispute — Kenji's core task has no button here.
Bottom half of the canvas is empty and 'Yours whatever a hub does' is awkward phrasing for a $0.00 line.
fixes: Add a 'Dispute / open challenge' card (or button on the H1 account row) so the referenced action is reachable.
Tighten the grid to remove dead space and reword to 'Yours, hub-independent'.

top_issues: The right column stacks five large buttons, two of them disabled ('Collateral unavailable', 'Receive USDC from H1'), and conflates faucet top-up with a collateral slider — no clear single task.
'Depository may pull 0.00' repeats under every token, and the 100%/0% slider plus three preset buttons are duplicate controls for one choice.
fixes: Split into two cards (Faucet; Receive setup) and hide disabled CTAs until actionable; replace the slider+presets with one collateral selector.
Show the 'may pull' figure only when non-zero.

top_issues: A 'Borrow' toggle exists but the captured state shows only lend fields, so the borrow flow (collateral, liquidation) is unjudged and likely absent.
Right side is empty under the pool card and the all-zero pool stats give no signal; the interest input has no validation hint.
fixes: Provide a Borrow state with required collateral and a liquidation-price readout.
Add a rate/term summary or recent offers beside the pool so the column earns its space.

top_issues: The screen is read-only: it promises 'Board, shares, takeovers' but offers no Add member / Change threshold / Issue shares control — Ravi cannot govern his DAO from here.
'Kind: Lazy (hash of its board)' is developer jargon, and ~70% of the canvas is empty.
fixes: Add primary actions (Add signer, Change threshold, Register entity) and a members table with roles.
Replace 'Lazy' with a plain label like 'Unregistered (identified by board hash)' and fill the layout.

top_issues: The right PER-COUNTERPARTY text is clipped at the viewport edge ('...Manage → Dispute' cut off) — a hard layout failure on the screen that is supposed to prove safety.
Hero number is 'Enforceable right now $0.00', which reads as 'you have nothing' instead of leading with net and showing enforceable as a proportion.
fixes: Constrain the right panel width / wrap the action line and surface a real 'Dispute H1' button instead of truncated instructions.
Lead with Total $90.00 and show 'Enforceable 0 / 90' as a labeled ratio.

top_issues: SECURED/AT RISK/YOU OWE columns render '·' for most rows — ambiguous between zero and unknown — and the book's 'live relay' tag touches the right edge.
KPI 'INSTANT SEND·RECEIVE $190.00·$352.75' mixes decimal precision and the two numbers have no clear relation to the table totals.
fixes: Use '0.00' (or a distinct '—' with a legend) instead of dots, and add column sort affordances.
Standardize decimals and tie each KPI to a table sum on hover.

top_issues: Command coverage is incomplete — no Settings, Ownership or Dispute entry — and the dimmed order book bleeds through the modal's right edge, hurting focus.
Hints like 'dense console' and 'batch, attention, doors' are cryptic to anyone but the designer.
fixes: Add Settings/Ownership/Dispute commands and a typed-query highlight state; darken the backdrop fully behind the palette.
Rewrite hints as verbs, e.g. 'open dense console', 'batch moves & review alerts'.

overall.verdict: A genuinely differentiated, well-typeset wallet whose trust language (provable frames, at-risk scale bars, enforceable-vs-trust split) is the best thing about it — but it ships several read-only or contradictory screens (Ownership, Move, the duplicated Activity detail) and leaks developer jargon that blocks first-timers and treasurers alike. The visual system is 800-grade; the interaction completeness is 650-grade, and that gap is what stops a recommend.
priority_fixes: Make governance and dispute reachable as actions: add Add-member/Change-threshold/Issue-shares on Ownership and a real 'Dispute' button on Manage, Account and Sovereignty (unblocks Ravi and Kenji).
Fix layout integrity bugs that read as broken: the clipped right-panel text on Sovereignty, the FROM==TO / amount-exceeds prefill on Move, and the missing distinct Activity-detail state.
On Swap, compute and show 'You receive' live, add a Market/quote mode, and stop coloring asks red (reserve red for disputes per Settings) so Anya can judge a fair fill.

Strip jargon from the first-timer path: replace 'capacity via H1', 'lanes', '1 empty hidden', 'Dollars per pixel', 'Lazy hash' with plain labels or tooltips, and collapse Receive's three copy buttons into one primary action (Maya, Fatima).
Add 'Forward/Share receipt' to the paid modal and ship the mobile layout (or mobile screenshots) so a one-hand checkout exists (Sofia, Lena).
